review.identity: Own adopted canonical reference used for both sheets; original watercolor texture, brown contour, oval eye construction, muzzle, species colors/markings and full tail retained.
review.style: All18 new raster keys inspected on correctly composited light and dark backgrounds. Texture is within silhouettes, no background/haze or floating symbols. Exact source RGBA pixels retained.
review.alpha: All18 cells have nonempty alpha8 visible bounds and at least2px clear margins on every side, with original alpha untouched.
review.motion: Tea hold/raise/sip/lower show actual cup-mouth contact and return. Bow stages are a gentle polite bend, without claiming measured geometric angles. Jump crouch/takeoff/air/land is distinct, both airborne baselines inferred and recorded. Dance uses opposite gentle leans and a one-foot step. These are discrete key-pose stocks; smooth interpolation and final timing remain scene work.
